title: Predicting sepsis within 24 hours at triage stage in emergency department using machine learning
summary: XGBoost predicts sepsis within 24 hours from triage data in MIMIC-IV, with a held-out test set and cross-validation; this is a specific retrospective clinical prediction study, without external or prospective model validation. This is a preprint, not a peer-reviewed publication.
